result: simulator regression passed; original physical acceptance remains pending

proven: Actual native Cmd-Shift-P opens the real production Command Palette from the Inspector To-do input.
The palette accepts native text input while the covered inspector controls are absent from native accessibility.
Native Tab and Shift-Tab are exercised with bounded navigation.
Actual scrim tap closes the palette and restores the invoking To-do input; after one second a native digit is appended to that input. Repeated per orientation.
Inspector touch-close restores the editor view in both orientations; app terminates and cleanly relaunches.

native_diagnostic_evidence.sequence: Actual touch pointerdown on palette overlay removes the nested dialog before pointerup, which then targets HTML. Native Context activation seen in a separate clean run was not reproduced in the event trace and is not asserted as proven click-through.

coverage: mobile nested inspector with invoking-input Escape and covered-control scrim press/release

limitations: Original R15-01, R15-02, R15-03 and R15-04 require physical iPhone/iPad acceptance and remain not-run.
No VoiceOver or physical hardware keyboard acceptance is claimed.
XCTest typeKey Escape, Return and Delete emitted no DOM key events in the recorded native diagnostic; native Escape/Return behavior is unproven. Browser Escape evidence is separate.
Native accessibility hasFocus is not equivalent to DOM activeElement; the observer records delayed DOM focus separately.
Native XCTest incurred five missing-animation-completion idle waits but completed all assertions and cleanup before the imposed limit. This is not a performance acceptance claim.
